data.name: DINO RUNNER: CHRONICLES
data.detailed_description:
DINO RUNNER: CHRONICLES is a lightning-fast, procedurally generated 2D platform runner that tests your reflexes to the absolute limit. Dodge, jump, and slide your way through beautifully handcrafted environments as the game progressively accelerates, challenging even the most hardened arcade runners.

Survive the Dash As you run, the speed dynamically increases. The closer you get to the dimensional portal at the end of the level, the faster and more chaotic the obstacles become. Precise timing is your only weapon against the hordes of ground cacti, toxic slimes, flying birds, and hovering drones. One wrong move, and it's game over.

Features:

8 Unique Dimensions: Run through distinct, beautifully rendered atmospheric levels featuring multi-layered parallax backgrounds and smooth gradient skies. Traverse environments ranging from the serene Green Plains to the absolute chaos of the Space Singularity.

Dynamic Difficulty: The game actively tracks your distance, smoothly accelerating your speed and increasing the obstacle spawn rates the further you progress.

Customizable Skins: Stand out! Choose from multiple unique dinosaur color palettes to match your style.

Smooth & Premium Experience: Built entirely in Rust, Dino Chronicles offers incredibly lightweight, buttery-smooth 60+ FPS gameplay with a gorgeous, neon-accented glassmorphism user interface.

Progressive Campaign: Clear levels by surviving long enough to reach the glowing portal gate. Your progress and settings are automatically saved so you can pick up right where you left off.

Are your reflexes sharp enough to beat the singularity? Run, survive, and conquer the chronicles!

data.short_description: DINO RUNNER: CHRONICLES is a fast-paced, procedurally generated 2D platform runner. Test your reflexes as you jump, dodge, and slide through 8 increasingly difficult dimensions. Reach the portal, unlock new skins, and survive the ever-accelerating dash!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 veya AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 veya OpenGL 3.3 destekli herhangi bir dahili grafik kartı
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standart dahili ses kartı
